# About me (source for my homepage)

Name: Dr. Priya Raman
Position: Associate Professor of Information
Department: School of Information, Lakeview University
Email: praman@lakeview.example.edu
Office: Room 4312, North Quad. Office hours Tuesdays 2–4 pm.

## Bio
I study how people and AI systems keep shared documents trustworthy over time. My lab builds provenance-aware writing tools and evaluates them with newsrooms, libraries and civic groups.

## Lab
Provenance & Collaboration Lab. Members: Jamie Ortiz (PhD), Mei Chen (PhD), Sam Patel (MSI).
Recruiting: one PhD student for Fall 2027.
